mediaComposer.scope: Bounded read-only static Media Composer effect-registration/resource review for Bella Effect Category. Distinguish the existing name-derived label, recorded MDB component effect identifiers, and a live effects palette. No plugin loading/execution, application launch, private API invocation, media writes or production edits.
plainMeaning: Precompute Category separates Rendered Effects from Titles and Matte Keys. Effect Category names a catalogue group such as Blend, Timewarp, Image or Sapphire Transitions. These are different fields.

Media Composer knows category/group information through its effect registrations and shipped registry. That knowledge is associated with an effect identifier/name in the application; it is not proof that a selected MDB precompute master directly records its original producer category.

Current MediaMuster extracts an effect-looking token from the selected precompute Clip Name and looks it up in a compiled catalogue. This is useful inferred naming because Clip Names are editable. It is not equivalent to reading a verified recorded effect ID from the MDB.

anchors: 0x746808..14 queries the AlphaFlex feature setting before dispatching registered numeric identifiers.

The branch0x746890..8b8 selects display name 3D Warp and category Blend when the toggle result is zero, or 3D Warp Legacy and Legacy when nonzero. It passes the internal identifier string EFF_SBLEND and display name to SetFundementals at0x7468cc..8d8.

The common category path at0x748b58..70 or0x749240..58 localizes a category string then invokes virtual+0x6f0. The AEffect vtable address point0x137ebc8 resolves that slot to AEffect::SetClassName0x75b76c.
SetClassName stores/copies the registered category name into the AEffect in-memory handle member+0xa0; it performs localization and string allocation/copy, not an MDB property read.

SetEffectInfo has other feature/version-dependent registration branches and an Unknown Effect/Unknown fallback. This review verifies the representative route; it does not freshly model every identifier/gate combination.
nativeBuiltinRegistration.terminology: AEffect ClassName here is an effect registry/palette group string. It is not an OMFI four-character object class, file Kind, Precompute Category or Mob identity.
nativeBuiltinRegistration.livePaletteLimit: Compiled registrations can include legacy/debug/hidden variants. Finding an entry does not establish that it is visible, enabled, licensed or executable in the current live session.

anchors: 0x411fc..218 reads the MCFirst setting;0x41224..234 reads AlphaFlex. Static registration output can depend on those gates.

0x4128c..412c0 writes a registration record for BLEND_SUPER/EFF2_BLEND_SUPER with public name Superimpose and class/category Blend.0x412d4..412fc writes BLEND_DISSOLVE/EFF2_BLEND_DISSOLVE with public name Dissolve and the same group.
The sampled public name/category pointers refer to little-endian UTF-32 wide string constants, independently decoded as Superimpose, Dissolve and Blend; this does not prescribe MDB text encoding.
Placeholder FXBaseProxyRegistration entries occur at the start of the initializer. The current catalogue documentation excludes these internal placeholder names.
nativePluginRegistration.limit: No plugin code was invoked. The historical 162-record/two-AlphaFlex-state extraction and 47-added-pair contribution remain prior catalogue provenance, not a freshly reconstructed full plugin registration model in this bounded pass.

knownIdentityProperties: OMFI:FXPS:attrEffectID and OMFI:FXPS:attrEffectIDLen, offsets+0x1658/+0x1660. These are effect identity/property payload routes, not a proven selected-master palette category field.
boundedNativeComponentRoute: The verified AComponent::Get path0x1482e8..308 reads CPNT:EffectID into the component optional effect-ID storage through its string reader and SetEffectIDHdl.

ATrackEffect::Get at0x1ef700..720 obtains its component effect-ID through virtual+0x2f0 and passes the identifier string to AEffectLibrary::FindEffect. ATrackEffect::GetEffect at0x1f3aac..acc has the same identifier-based lookup boundary.

The ATrackEffect vtable slot+0x2f0 resolves to ATrackGroup::GetEffectID0x1eb97c, which forwards to AComponent::GetEffectID0x1492f8. This is an identifier lookup route, not a call to parse a precompute Clip Name.
recordedMDBIdentityVersusCatalogueGroup.ownershipLimit: An effect ID found on an RSET, FXCP, FXPS, source component or unrelated object may describe that structural component rather than establish the selected precompute original rendering effect. Owner/relationship and meaning must be proven before using such an ID. The raw selected-master audit is handled independently by the data agent.
recordedMDBIdentityVersusCatalogueGroup.categoryPropertyLimit: No explicit selected-master MDB palette-category property has been established for this result field. The property-name dictionary and bounded native routes do not prove a global absence from every private MDB layout or arbitrary attribute blob. Current MediaMuster does not read a direct category property; it deliberately uses the Clip Name catalogue inference.

currentLookupPreservation.entryPoint: AvidEffects::lookup(const QString& clipName), src/effectcatalogue.cpp:965 at review time.
contract: It is called for metadata-proven precomputes and returns recognized effect name, category/group(s), sequence text, instance and matched flag.
The shared table is built once from compiled UTF-8 strings. Names and localized aliases are indexed by the existing space/colon-to-underscore spelling convention.
The explicit 3DWarp compatibility alias is preserved; general space removal, case folding and approximate/fuzzy matching are not introduced.
One spelling can legitimately map to several groups; current lookup joins distinct matching categories with slash separators rather than arbitrarily choosing a group.

Unrecognized tokens preserve their text and unknown category. A renamed/custom title/template can remain unrecognized; an accidental known-name match can still be misleading because the original Clip Name is editable.
currentLookupPreservation.approvalBoundary: The user likes current Effect Category behavior and asks for an elegant equivalent. Preserve the verified catalogue and current matching semantics; do not replace this with a new arbitrary component-graph effect-identity search or live application/plugin query.

bellaRecommendationForParent: Reuse the existing immutable catalogue and exact name-recognition logic. Run the lookup from the selected decoded Clip Name after Type is established as Precompute, once per distinct required master/name context where possible.
Preserve original Clip Name and inferred/matched/ambiguous status. Keep the category/effect/sequence result together so the same name is not repeatedly parsed for three columns.

A small shared catalogue index/handle can represent matched categories if future profiling justifies it; do not redesign the already compact pure lookup or claim speed/memory gains without measurement.
Do not read import-settings bodies, every effect component, plugin registry files or application binaries during a Bella media scan solely to produce the current inferred Effect Category column.

Keep unavailable/unmatched presentation policy explicit and separate from the approved Precompute Category blank rule. This review does not silently change current unknown labeling, infer a verified effect ID, remove optional precompute features, or settle future source/header scheduling.
limits: Fresh source/registry pair counts and representative built-in/plugin category paths are verified, while the earlier full 887-pair registration and localization provenance remains historical.
No full live palette reconstruction, universal MDB absence proof, executable-plugin check or exact Media Composer UI clone.
No new runtime code, app cutover, tests or benchmarks performed.

mdvx.purpose: Bounded ordinary MDVx Effect Category omission audit, with current MediaMuster catalogue-lookup behavior supplied as separate source context.
mdvx.method: Fresh installed MDVx SHA256; bounded rereading of retained exact functions for that identical hash. Current application source/doc inspection and a textual catalogue-entry count. No live app/scan/export/filter, private API, new media/MDB read, production edit or new test/build.
mdvx.mainFinding: Ordinary MDVx does not derive or retain a separate effect token, palette category or catalogue lookup result in its matched-file scan-to-row-to-table/CSV/filter path. Current MediaMuster derives these labels from an already selected precompute Clip Name and its bundled catalogue; this is inference from editable text, not an MDB effect identity.

ordinaryMDVx.entry: -[MDVxOMFI addInfoToItem:] 0x100064794. Selected PMR-associated master is found through the eight-byte ID excerpt/CompositionMobs lookup.
ordinaryMDVx.name: At 0x1000648d4..8ec, GetStringForObjectAt supplies the master text copied to DB_NameInBin. There is no effect-token suffix parser, category lookup or catalogue interpretation in this ordinary block.
ordinaryMDVx.usage: MOBJ:UsageCode is retained, with _IMPORTSETTING name-prefix override to synthetic15. Neither usage3 label UC_EFFECT nor usage15 label IMPORTED identifies a palette group such as Image, Timewarp or a plug-in group.
ordinaryMDVx.row: Complete row metadata has no independent effect name/token/category/sequence field. The retained raw Clip Name can contain such text, but it is not parsed into this field.
ordinaryMDVx.tableAndCSV: Complete ordinary table and string-export methods have no Effect Category or effect-token branch. KindCellID uses raw usage-label table at 0x1000e94d0. ExportMenu genCsv calls the ordinary string method at 0x100067e24; it does not add a separate catalogue field.
ordinaryMDVx.filter: MDVxFilter itemPassFilter at 0x10000c0b0 uses precompute/imported/audio gates and text checks against names/Project/path. It has no independent effect-category equality or catalogue lookup stage.
ordinaryMDVx.headerRowFallback: Inspected MDVxMXF addInfoToItem at 0x1000326b4 copies Clip Name, Project and UIDs only, not derived effect fields.
ordinaryMDVx.wholeAppLimit: Embedded AAF dictionary symbols include OperationDefinition.OperationCategory and PluginDefinition.PluginCategory. Their presence is not an ordinary palette-label projection. This receipt does not assert raw browsers or every embedded library cannot inspect effects.

currentMediaMusterContext.keyRules: mangle at lines952..957 replaces space and colon with underscore. Lookup at lines1031..1037 uses exact case-sensitive QString keys. Seven shipped-language aliases and the explicit 3DWarp compatibility alias are retained. No generic case folding, approximate matching or arbitrary whitespace removal.
currentMediaMusterContext.tokenParser: lookup lines965..1029 recognizes the right-hand effect token in sequence,Effect+N or sequence,Effect,N[.new.N...] conventions. It validates anchored numeric suffixes and integer range; malformed/overflow suffixes are not silently accepted as valid instances. Sequence commas/spelling are retained in the returned text.
currentMediaMusterContext.ambiguity: At lines1039..1047, a matched key uses the first matching English display name and joins every distinct category in catalogue order with / separators. Category ambiguity is not collapsed to an arbitrary single group.
currentMediaMusterContext.unknown: Unmatched token remains raw as Hit.name with category unknown. Renamed clips or coincidental known tokens can miss or misleadingly match; this is not proof of actual producer/effect identity.
currentMediaMusterContext.row: mediaengineadapter.cpp lines64..66 copies the three strings to MediaFile effect/effectCategory/effectSequence. Type is established independently and does not change because the name matches.
currentMediaMusterContext.display: MediaFile::effectCategoryDisplay at mediafile.h lines201..205 is blank for non-precomputes and otherwise uses the stored category or lowercase unknown. Table and enabled detail CSV call this shared function.
currentMediaMusterContext.sortAndSearch: Optional precompute detail columns are feature gated. Search includes the same visible category/effect labels on precomputes; category sorting is case-insensitive display text. These are current behavior facts, not a newly approved Bella policy.
currentMediaMusterContext.ioBoundary: The pure lookup itself performs no source I/O. Current coordinator lines171..178 do not request a header merely because effect/category/sequence are absent; only an unresolved recorded conflict among these can contribute a request. Other fields can independently require headers.
currentMediaMusterContext.limits: Current source header comments and existing test/doc claims are not fresh native proof or a new passing test run.

The current lookup already returns all three related values and shares its immutable index; it is not inherently a new per-row filesystem or plug-in scan.

A simpler Bella integration can derive once after the selected master Type/Clip Name is final, reuse the result for associated rows and avoid separate graph walks or repeated source reconciliation solely for a name-derived label. No measured speed or memory improvement is claimed.

The agreed Type blank-unknown behavior does not automatically alter current Effect Category lowercase unknown. Effect, EffectSequence and Precompute Category remain distinct fields.

agreedBellaRule.status: Approved by the user on 20 October 2026: preserve current Effect Category behaviour with the simpler integration; not yet implemented. Effect and Effect Sequence detailed reviews remain open.

preserve: Current compiled catalogue and AvidEffects::lookup semantics, including all 887 distinct pairs, localized aliases and explicit 3DWarp compatibility alias.

Derive once after selected Type/Clip Name is final; reuse result in the same selected master/name processing scope. Recompute if selected inputs change. Return a compact value containing the existing related labels.
agreedBellaRule.retention: Keep needed result strings and compact derived context. QString implicit sharing can share selected values across associated rows. No additional MDB effect graph, live plugin/registry scan, header read solely for this label, permanent cache of every name or repeated full evidence histories for three labels.
agreedBellaRule.buildingBlocks: Existing C++17 AvidEffects::Hit value-return function; pinned Qt 6.5.3 QString and shared immutable QHash table. No large category enum or custom interner needed.
